operations.name: anime.get
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListAnimeApi.get gets one anime by its MyAnimeList ID through `MalAnimeOperation.get`. It is the public facade for the `GET /anime/{id}` endpoint; use MalRequestOptions.fields to select the response shape and MalRequestOptions transport settings to override per call.
operations.auth: Not required for public anime data; pass an access token for list-related fields.

request.name: params
request.description: The anime lookup inputs; a MalAnimeGetParams carrying the MyAnimeList anime ID.

nestedFields.name: id
nestedFields.description: The MyAnimeList anime ID.

request.name: options
request.description: Optional field selection and transport settings; a MalRequestOptions merged over the instance defaults.

nestedFields.name: fields
nestedFields.description: A comma-separated field selector, or the same selector as an array.

nestedFields.name: timeout
nestedFields.description: Milliseconds before a request is aborted. `0` disables the Axios timeout. Defaults to DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT; timeout errors carry the effective duration as `AniLinkNetworkError.timeoutMs`.

nestedFields.name: signal
nestedFields.description: Signal used to cancel in-flight requests.

response.name: id
response.description: The MyAnimeList numeric identifier.

response.name: title
response.description: The canonical MyAnimeList title.

response.name: main_picture
response.description: Optional image variants requested through the `fields` query parameter.

nestedFields.name: large
nestedFields.description: The large image URL, when MyAnimeList provides one.

nestedFields.name: medium
nestedFields.description: The medium image URL, when MyAnimeList provides one.

response.name: synopsis
response.description: The synopsis, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: status
response.description: The publication/airing status, when requested (one of MAL's status values such as `finished_airing`).

response.name: mean
response.description: The average score out of 10, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: num_episodes
response.description: The total number of episodes, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: media_type
response.description: The media type, when requested (for example `tv`, `movie`, or `ova`).

response.name: start_date
response.description: The first air/start date in ISO 8601 format, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: broadcast
response.description: The broadcast schedule, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

nestedFields.name: day_of_the_week
nestedFields.description: The day of the week the anime broadcasts in Japan time, or `other`.

nestedFields.name: start_time
nestedFields.description: The broadcast start time in JST in `HH:mm` form, when MyAnimeList provides one.

response.name: average_episode_duration
response.description: The average episode duration in seconds, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

errors.condition: for timeout, cancellation, or other transport failures

operations.example:
const api = new AniLink({ mal: { accessToken: "mal-token" } }).mal;
const anime = await api.anime.get({ id: 21 }, { fields: ["id", "title", "main_picture"] });

operations.name: anime.updateMyListStatus
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListAnimeApi.updateMyListStatus updates the authenticated user's anime list status through `MalAnimeOperation.updateMyListStatus`. It is the public facade for `PATCH /anime/{id}/my_list_status` and requires a MAL access token from `MalCredentials.accessToken` via `buildMyAnimeListApi`; send only the `MalAnimeListStatusUpdate` fields you want to change, form-encoded as MAL requires.
operations.auth: Required: MAL OAuth2 access token (`mal.accessToken` credential slot).

request.name: params
request.description: The list-status write inputs; a MalAnimeListStatusUpdateParams carrying the anime ID plus only the fields to change.

nestedFields.name: id
nestedFields.description: The MyAnimeList anime ID.

nestedFields.name: status
nestedFields.description: The watch status to set; one of MalAnimeListStatusValue.

nestedFields.name: num_watched_episodes
nestedFields.description: The number of episodes the user has watched.

nestedFields.name: score
nestedFields.description: The user's score out of 10.

nestedFields.name: start_date
nestedFields.description: The date the user started watching, in ISO 8601 form; MAL also accepts partial dates (`YYYY-MM` or `YYYY`).

nestedFields.name: finish_date
nestedFields.description: The date the user finished watching, in ISO 8601 form; MAL also accepts partial dates (`YYYY-MM` or `YYYY`).

nestedFields.name: comments
nestedFields.description: Free-form notes the user attached to the entry.

nestedFields.name: is_rewatching
nestedFields.description: Whether the user is currently rewatching the anime.

nestedFields.name: num_times_rewatched
nestedFields.description: The number of times the user has rewatched the anime.

nestedFields.name: rewatch_value
nestedFields.description: The rewatch value rating (0-5).

nestedFields.name: priority
nestedFields.description: The priority rating (0-2).

nestedFields.name: tags
nestedFields.description: User-defined tags attached to the entry; sent as a comma-separated string.
